name: TCM Quiz Pipeline
description: Generates MCQ CSVs from study files: resolves source via tcm-idrive's SQLite index, drives NotebookLM via tcm-notebooklm, writes CSV to a separate output bucket. Reuses notebooks per topic. Exposes openclaw tcm quiz ... CLI and an mcq_status tool.

outputBucket.description: S3 bucket where generated CSVs land.

endpoint.description: IDrive e2 endpoint URL (same as tcm-idrive).

sourceBucket.description: S3 bucket holding study files (same as tcm-idrive).

dataDir.description: Local state directory shared with tcm-idrive.
